'''Twylope Nur''' was a [[Mohsenian]] who served the [[Resistance]] as a field [[medic]]. He used his ability to smell illness and injury, alongside his natural resistance and defenses, to diagnose his patients and quickly deliver appropriate treatment. He was part of the Resistance group that set up [[Resistance base (Ajan Kloss)|base]] on the [[moon]] [[Ajan Kloss]] and was present when the [[YT-1300 light freighter]] known as the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' returned ablaze from a [[Mission to Sinta Glacier Colony|mission]] to [[Sinta Glacier Colony]].

==Biography==
Twylope Nur was a [[Mohsenian]] who served the [[Resistance]] as a field [[medic]] during their [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] against the [[First Order]]. He was part of the core Resistance group<ref name="TROS VD" /> that set up base on the [[jungle]] [[moon]] of [[Ajan Kloss]] under the command of [[General]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]].<ref name="TROS">{{Film|IX}}</ref>

[[File:Twylope_Nur_Falcon.png|thumb|left|250px|Twylope Nur was amongst the response crew who rushed to the damaged ''Millennium Falcon''.]]
In [[35 ABY]], he was present in the base when the [[YT-1300 light freighter]] known as the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' returned from a [[Mission to Sinta Glacier Colony|mission]] to the [[Sinta Glacier Colony]]. The [[starship]] was heavily damaged and on fire, and Nur was amongst the Resistance personnel who rushed forward to aid in putting out the flames and helping the crew. While the others were tending to the fire, Nur was knelt down in front of the vessel attending to something on the ground.<ref name="TROS" />

Following Organa's [[death]], Nur later attended a meeting at the base led by Generals [[Poe Dameron]] and [[Finn]], who laid out a plan to [[Battle of Exegol|attack]] the [[Sith Eternal military|forces]] of the [[Sith Eternal]] on the [[planet]] [[Exegol]]. The Resistance ultimately emerged victorious with aid from [[Citizens' Fleet|allies]] from around [[the galaxy]], and following the battle Nur took part in celebrations held on Ajan Kloss, jumping up and down amidst the crowds of joyous allies.<ref name="TROS" />

==Personality and traits==
Nur was an amiable individual and was well suited to his role as a medic due to the fact he could smell illness, injury and the bodies natural defenses fighting against them using the sensitive olfactory receptors that lined his long snout. This allowed him to diagnose patients quickly and accurately then administer appropriate treatments. He had large black [[eye]]s, white [[Hair|fur]] and cream skin.<ref name="TROS VD" />

==Equipment==
Nur wore a brown [[Clothing|tunic]] over a white shirt and a brown [[belt]].<ref name="TROS VD" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Wizard_43.png|thumb|right|200px|Wizard 43 by Luke Fisher]]
Twylope Nur was created for the [[2019]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']],<ref name="TROS" /> and was first identified in the accompanying reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="TROS VD" /> Concept art of Nur titled "Wizard 43" was created by creature concept designer and senior sculptor [[Luke Fisher]] for the film.<ref name="Art">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker]]''</ref> Twylope Nur was played by puppeteer and creature performer Mohsen Nouri, whose name<ref name="Facebook">{{Facebook|username=Skywalkersignings-uk-101887251657960|url=watch/?v=839038436822741|name=Skywalkersignings uk|date=2021-04-02|archiveurl=https://archive.md/Fw8qL}}</ref> was also used as [[Tuckerization|inspiration]] for Twylope's species - Mohsenian.<ref name="TROS VD" />
